notes: «أبي - رحمه الله -» names the compiler's father by relation only; the blessing is left out
The bracketed «[عن أبيه]» is an editor's insertion the text writes, so it is read as a link (relation); «عن آبائه» is a collective of unnamed forefathers
The Imam is named only in the words after the chain (“قال أمير المؤمنين”), so he is the last link as imam_in_text
